messages:
bob_customer: Hey, urgent — our org set a custom retention TTL to 90 days last month but records are being deleted after ~30 days. Compliance flagged it, need an immediate hold and timeline for affected data.

alice_support: Sorry to hear that, @bob_customer. Can you share the org id and an example message id or two? I'll loop in eng & security. :eyes:

dana_engineer: tagging in. Do you have the retention rule id or the API request that applied the TTL? quick check: are these objects flagged as `conversation` or `audit` types?

bob_customer: org: org-8421. One example id: msg_2026_03_10_5f8a. Policy was created via the console: Team → Data retention → Custom rule (90d). We also applied a legal-hold via support ticket last week (ticket #5421).

alice_support: I see ticket #5421, it was marked as "pending" in our queue. @dana_engineer any signs the legal-hold didn't attach to that rule?

dana_engineer: pulling retention config for org-8421 now. Running internal API: ```GET /internal/v1/orgs/org-8421/retention-rules``` response looks off — one rule shows `ttl_days: 30` and `applies_to: conversations` and another `ttl_days: 90` scoped to `embeds`. Possible mismatch where the console change didn't patch the active rule.

carlos_sec: @dana_engineer please pause deletion workers for org-8421 ASAP and export audit logs. If legal hold was requested it must override TTL. Also check KMS key access for older objects — if key rotation failed, deletion job might have taken a different code path.

deploy-bot: daily-deletion-job (job-id: ddj-20260312) started at 2026-03-12T03:00:12Z. Processed 47,122 objects. 12 objects deleted for org-8421. 5 objects skipped (kms-decrypt-fail).

dana_engineer: copying relevant log snippet: ```[2026-03-12T03:02:43Z] org=org-8421 object=msg_2026_03_10_5f8a action=delete rule=rule-231 ttl_days=30 reason=expired``` That object is listed under rule-231 (30d).

bob_customer: but the console shows rule-999 (90d) as the active policy for the team. We didn't touch rule-231.

emma_support_manager: @alice_support I'm taking over the escalation. Next steps: 1) confirm whether deleted objects are restorable from cold backups; 2) reconcile rule mappings between console and active backend; 3) produce a timeline + root cause for compliance.

alice_support: Noted. @dana_engineer can you push a temporary hold flag on org-8421? Endpoint: `POST /internal/v1/orgs/org-8421/retention-hold` with body `{ "reason": "compliance_escalation_5421" }`.

dana_engineer: Hold API accepted. ```POST /internal/v1/orgs/org-8421/retention-hold -> 202 Accepted {"hold_id":"hold-78a"}``` Workers will skip deletions for objects tagged by hold-78a.

carlos_sec: Exporting audit log for retention-rule changes: ```grep -i "rule-231" /var/log/retention/audit.log | tail -n 20``` shows an entry: `2026-02-10T11:15:09Z user=ops-bot changed ttl from 90->30 rule=rule-231 scope=conversations`. That explains why backend applied 30d. Need to see who triggered ops-bot or automated migration.

bob_customer: Who has permission to alter rules via ops-bot? We rely on console for governance.

emma_support_manager: We'll map the ops-bot actor. Also: Bob, for deleted objects — we may be able to restore from cold snapshots if they exist; that process is manual and has a SLA. Estimated time to complete restore investigation: 48 hours.

bob_customer: 48h is tight but acceptable for now. Can you confirm the default system retention for new orgs? We need to ensure defaults aren't shorter than customers expect.

dana_engineer: Default account-level TTL is 365 days for conversations unless an override exists. Rules are evaluated by specificity: conversation-level rule > team-level > org default. Looks like an automated migration created a conversation-level rule with 30d that superseded the team console rule.

carlos_sec: Also checking KMS logs: `kms-audit` shows a key rotation operation on 2026-02-09 that completed successfully; decrypt errors were transient due to a mis-synced replica (5 objects failed decrypt and were marked for retry). Not related to TTL mismatch.

alice_support: Action items created: #1 reconcile rule-change actor (ops-bot) — @dana_engineer; #2 restore investigation — @emma_support_manager; #3 confirm freeze is in place — @dana_engineer. Will update ticket #5421.

dana_engineer: Freeze confirmed, deletion workers will skip org-8421 until hold removed. Also flagged ops-bot change for rollback.

emma_support_manager: I'll email compliance with the timeline and proposed mitigations. Bob, we'll post updates in this thread and via the ticket. Thanks for raising quickly. :raised_hands:

bob_customer: thanks everyone. please CC our legal team on any final audit export: legal@custco.example.com

alice_support: Added the legal contact to ticket #5421. We'll follow up with the 48h restore estimate and a summary of who/what changed.
